In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, RTD fruit juices are claimed as healthy food by providing health related claims, mostly on vitamin C.
the RTD fruit juices in modern retail provide claims on the product label, but the claims are not always based on the addition of functional ingredients.
the RTD juice industries in Indonesia are able to provide the health claim on the label, if the raw material is able to provide the nutrient content as the claim.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RTD fruit juice in Indonesia is still able to meet the regulation of claim requirement, and the claim on vitamin C is still the most favorite claim in RTD juice industry.
, there is a lot of room for improvement for juice industry to provide health related claims, especially in vitamin A and dietary fiber.
RTD fruit juices in modern retail provide health claims and functional ingredients to meet the regulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RTD juice manufacturers are able to provide health related claim on the label.
, in order to provide the health claim, RTD juice industries can use the functional ingredient, but it is not the only way to get the claim.
the use of functional ingredient in RTD fruit juice has been increasing, but not yet reach 50%, so the use of functional ingredients still needs to be increased to support the claim.
